one_liner: Michael Porter Jr. shoots 38.5 percent from three while recording just 2.3 assists per 36 minutes -- a pure finisher's line.
three_things: 38.5 percent from three on a 21.1-point-per-36 scoring rate.
2.3 assists per 36 is among the lowest playmaking rates of any high-scoring wing here.
He rebounds at 7.7 per 36, more than the assist and playmaking numbers suggest.
context_note: Per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not full-career figures. The manifest is descriptive_only: no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty, and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor applies. Games and minutes measure availability, not how well those minutes were used.
